## Constraints

### Must

- Artwork is never cropped (object-fit: contain)
- 44x44 px touch targets and WCAG AA contrast in both themes
- Mobile first at 390 px; distinct desktop composition; no overflow at 320 px
- Tokens only, no hard-coded colors

### Avoid

- Decorative material/soil textures and serif display type (retired Carried Ground look)
- Uppercase letter-spaced body copy

## Decisions

- 2026-10-31: Direction E · White Cube selected for the whole portfolio over A Material Register, B Wall at Scale, C Series Chapters, D Open Field, F Studio Bento — most professional for galleries and collectors, artwork-first, simplest to prerender and keep fast.
